collection.title: Jaguar XJ X350 2003 to 2007 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Jaguar XJ X350 2003 to 2007 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment with the Spray Bar attachment. There is also the option to upgrade to the newer Retrofit style wiper blades.
